title: Glowing paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- palette wooden body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='28' fill='#C98A4B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#E0A96D'/>
  <!-- thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='64' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3A2A5A'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#4A3A6A'/>
  <!-- paint blobs -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='6' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='6' fill='#4DC9FF'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#A3E4FF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='6' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#FFF0A3'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='52' r='5' fill='#6BFF6B'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='52' r='3' fill='#B3FFB3'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='54' r='5' fill='#C97BFF'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='54' r='3' fill='#E3B3FF'/>
  <!-- paintbrush resting across -->
  <rect x='55' y='68' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(-20 55 68)'/>
  <rect x='78' y='58' width='10' height='7' rx='2' fill='#D9D9D9' transform='rotate(-20 78 58)'/>
  <rect x='85' y='54' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FF4D6D' transform='rotate(-20 85 54)'/>
  <!-- glow accents -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='36' fill='none' stroke='#FFF2A8' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='40' fill='none' stroke='#FFF2A8' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.25'/>
</svg>
